rows.en: ＊Eiji＊＠０４９＿０１Oh, come on... Just 'cause it's￥your day off doesn't mean you￥can laze around.
＊Eiji＊＠０４９＿０２Isn't that why your scores￥aren't improving? Last time￥was awful, right?
＊Eiji＊＠０４９＿０４If you really want to go to￥Elan, you need to take training￥more seriously.
＊Eiji＊＠０４９＿０５Right?￥You'd better put more effort￥into your training.＝＠０４９＿０６That is, if you really want￥to go to Elan.
＊Eiji＊＠０４９＿０７Otherwise, you're just dragging￥down the other candidates who￥are working hard.＝＠０４９＿０８Everyone here seriously￥wants to go to Elan.
＊Eiji＊＠０４９＿０９I thought you were the type to￥take that stuff seriously,￥but...＝＠０４９＿１０guess not. You're pretty￥half-assed, huh?
＊Eiji＊＠０４９＿１１If you don't want people￥thinking that, get serious.＝＠０４９＿１２Otherwise, whatever you say￥just sounds like sour grapes.
＊Eiji＊＠０４９＿１３Don't just shrug it off...￥You get it, right?￥You're a candidate!
＊Eiji＊＠０４９＿１４Can't you at least say￥"I'll try harder"?
＊Eiji＊＠０４９＿１５Anyway, you know things look￥bad if you keep this up, right?＝＠０４９＿１６Better fix it before everyone￥gives up on you.＝＠０４９＿１７See ya.
